title: What's new in v2.73.0
content:
Feature:
- Magic layer with 4 magics for dynamic animation:
  + Parallax
  + Skew
  + Tween (color values, displacement, size, rotation)
  + Wave
- Animated PNG export

Enhancements:
- PSD export to use the selected frame index instead of always using the first index.
- More performant pixel grid for bigger canvases
- Some minor UI enhancements.
- Some minor fixes.
